content: DOCX JS libs: mammoth = DOCX->HTML/text extraction (read-only, the standard for display); docxtemplater/docx-templates = template-placeholder filling (need {tags} in source doc, wrong fit for editing arbitrary uploads); docx (dolanmiu) = declarative generation; docxml runs in Deno; JSZip + direct document.xml run-level editing preserves user formatting for arbitrary uploaded resumes.
